scope: Episode 01 visible runtime props first, then Section 0 Field Guide items
governing_rule: No image generation or final promotion before Korean-site product/assembly verification.

sources.title: 산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제11조 작업장의 출입구
산업안전보건기준에 관한 규칙 제21조 통로의 조명

site_gate.verified: Korean rule requires pedestrian entrance separation where a loading/transport entrance is the primary entrance; exact gate geometry is site-specific.
site_gate.render_contract: Do not invent a foreign turnstile/gate. Use a Korean apartment-site reference photo before final rendering.

material_stack.verified: Keep same-spec materials separated, stable on dunnage/supports, secured, and out of the travel route. Exact material in Episode 01 must be chosen from the authored scene/site reference.
material_stack.render_contract: No mixed-size decorative stack. Show one identified Korean-site material family only.

access_barrier.verified: Freestanding high-visibility PE barriers and traffic cones are current Korean market products; law/guidance controls function, not one universal barrier shape.
access_barrier.render_contract: Select one Korean product family and preserve its real feet/body/reflective geometry. No generic US/EU crowd-control barrier.

vehicle_overlap_zone.verified: This is a conflict relationship between vehicle and pedestrian routes, not a standalone piece of equipment.
vehicle_overlap_zone.render_contract: Render as map/scene overlay geometry only; do not image-generate a fictional physical object.

exclusion_zone.verified: Exclusion is created by barriers/cones/tape/signage and work control appropriate to the task.
exclusion_zone.render_contract: Compose from verified Korean barrier/cone assets in the scene; no standalone magical exclusion-zone prop.

open_edge.verified: A slab/platform edge or opening requires guardrail/fence/net/cover protection depending on the condition.
open_edge.render_contract: Use a real RC slab-edge scene fragment. Do not render an abstract 'open edge' object.

wet_floor.verified: Wet/slippery condition is a ground state and housekeeping hazard.
wet_floor.render_contract: Use wet concrete/soil surface decal or scene variation, not an isolated 3D item.

harness_unclipped.verified: Use a KCs-certified full-body harness family. Episode 01 may use a twin-Y double-lanyard configuration, but that configuration is not asserted as a universal Korean legal requirement.
harness_unclipped.render_contract: Brand-neutral Korean KCs-style full-body harness; correct D-ring, lanyards/hooks and shock-absorbing component where the selected certified product has them.

temporary_distribution_board.approved_visual_family: FRP temporary distribution board commonly used on Korean construction sites; lockable enclosure, protected live parts, grounding/RCD management.
reject: foreign NEMA-style site box without Korean reference

hard_stop: If a visual family is still site-specific/unresolved, request or search a Korean reference before calling image generation.
